get_filename_component(_cppbuild_project_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../ECOCppLoggerView" ABSOLUTE)

_cppbuild_collect_sources(_cppbuild_sources _cppbuild_modules "src" "include")

add_executable(ECOCppLoggerView ${_cppbuild_sources})
set_target_properties(ECOCppLoggerView PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "ECOCppLoggerView")
# Visual Studio debugs in the Project directory, where CppBuild's run and the tests start too.
set_target_properties(ECOCppLoggerView PROPERTIES VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY "${_cppbuild_project_dir}")
target_include_directories(ECOCppLoggerView PRIVATE "${_cppbuild_project_dir}/include")
target_compile_options(ECOCppLoggerView PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:CXX,MSVC>:/utf-8;/Zc:__cplusplus>" "$<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:C,MSVC>:/utf-8>")
target_link_libraries(ECOCppLoggerView PRIVATE ECOCppLogger::ECOCppLogger_static)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(ECOCppLoggerView PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:/W3>")
endif()
set_target_properties(ECOCppLoggerView PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(DEFINED ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_CXX_STANDARD)
  set_target_properties(ECOCppLoggerView PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD ${ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_CXX_STANDARD})
endif()
if(ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
  set_target_properties(ECOCppLoggerView PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ECOCppLogger_ECOCppLoggerView_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"

endif()

if(_cppbuild_modules)

    message(FATAL_ERROR "ECOCppLoggerView has C++ module interface units, which need CMake 3.28 or later")

  target_sources(ECOCppLoggerView PRIVATE FILE_SET cppbuild_modules TYPE CXX_MODULES
    BASE_DIRS "${_cppbuild_project_dir}" FILES ${_cppbuild_modules})
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CPPBUILD_MODULE_TARGETS ECOCppLoggerView)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  # DLLs the program loads (imported libraries, libraries with their own output directory)
  # beside it, so it starts from Visual Studio, CppBuild's run or the tests alike.
  add_custom_command(TARGET ECOCppLoggerView POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E "$<IF:$<BOOL:$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:ECOCppLoggerView>>,copy_if_different,true>"
